description: Eight years to the day after Susan Collins voted to confirm Brett Kavanaugh to the Supreme Court, Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate Troy Jackson will face Collins in their first debate tonight.

title: EIGHT YEARS AFTER COLLINS’ KAVANAUGH VOTE, JACKSON WILL PUT ABORTION RIGHTS FRONT & CENTER AT DEBATE
